headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to coordinate how the country prepares for space weather events.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up coordinated federal efforts to get the nation ready for space weather events. Space weather means disturbances from the sun, such as solar storms, that can affect things on Earth. No summary was provided, so the specific duties and rules in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to work together on preparing the nation for space weather events.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 13, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
